mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is 61 degrees with clear skies at Verona City Hall. We are currently under an elevated air quality alert with an index of 55, and the night sky is illuminated by a Full Moon.

The City of Verona is inviting the community to participate in the I Voted sticker design contest. Students in grades K-12 submitted 53 original designs, and now it is your turn to head online to the city website to vote for your favorites in four age categories through August 7. The winning stickers will be featured at the polls this November.

We have a busy schedule today, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can enjoy Concerts in the Park tomorrow at Century School Park.
In our weekly police report, on July 26, officers responded to a hit and run crash at West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane where the driver was cited for an improper left turn.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM today. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, get ready for Caramel Turtle.
